SRC001.title: Payment resilience consultation
SRC001.content: A draft consultation proposes resilience testing for UK merchant acquirers. It is a proposal, not a rule in force. Responses are invited by 15 December 2026.

SRC002.title: EU payment data review
SRC002.content: An industry review invites payment processors operating in the EU to assess cross-border data arrangements. No mandatory implementation date has been announced.

SRC003.title: Solar grid access bulletin
SRC003.content: A new application review process is planned for UK solar and battery projects. Existing applications will require a completeness check.

SRC004.title: Older payment resilience bulletin
SRC004.content: The bulletin reports that resilience testing will become mandatory on 1 November 2026. This conflicts with the newer consultation, which describes a proposal.
